name: two dark tokens swap values
catches: declares the light tokens in bare :root and the dark ones in the second token block, each with its colour-scheme

name: the panel ground is a hex instead of a token
catches: carry no raw colour outside the token blocks

edits.from: border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--panel);
edits.to: border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: #ffffff;

name: the row rule is renamed while the script still emits row
catches: name no class the page never emits

name: the row kinds are styled under a class the script never emits
catches: name no class the page never emits

name: a row kind is renamed in the renderer while the stylesheet keeps the old one
catches: give every class the page emits at least one rule

name: the body font goes back to fourteen pixels on a shorter line
catches: set the page's type in rem on the sans stack, one and a half lines high

name: the empty state is emitted while both of its rules are gone
catches: give every class the page emits at least one rule

edits.from:
.rows .empty { color: var(--fg-faint); font-size: .8rem; padding: 4px 0; }
  #mid .rows .empty { font-size: inherit; text-align: center; padding: 20px 0; }
